program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((objs (sort (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 1)) (objects g 0))
                     (lambda (a b)
                       (cond [(not (= (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))
                              (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b)))]
                             [(not (= (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))) (< (obj-r1 a) (obj-r1 b))]
                             [else (< (obj-c1 a) (obj-c1 b))])))))
    (for/fold ([out (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0)])
              ([obj (in-list objs)]
               [depth (in-naturals 2)])
      (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) depth))))
